title: Stdlib or Third-Party? Empirical Performance and Correctness of LLM-Assisted Zero-Dependency Python Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2605.21405v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Third-party Python libraries introduce dependency-management overhead, supply-chain risk, and deployment friction. We study when eliminating a dependency preserves enough correctness and performance to justify the gains in footprint, deployability, and trust surface. Our testbed is zerodep, 44 single-file, stdlib-only Python modules spanning 12 categories, each benchmarked against its reference library.   Three performance regimes emerge. Stdlib-only implementations achieve parity (within 2x) in the majority of cases; many outperform their references by 5x-115x where architectural overhead dominates; and a clear cliff appears for C-extension-backed computation (image processing, binary serialization, low-level crypto), confirmed by PyPy JIT and profiling experiments. translated_title: 标准库还是第三方库？LLM辅助的零依赖Python库的性能与正确性实证研究
translated_abstract: 第三方Python库会带来依赖管理开销、供应链风险和部署摩擦。我们研究在何种情况下消除依赖仍能保持足够的正确性和性能，从而证明其在占用空间、可部署性和信任面上的收益是值得的。我们的测试平台是zerodep，即44个单文件、仅使用标准库的Python模块，涵盖12个类别，每个模块都与其对应的参考库进行了基准测试对比。实验揭示了三种性能模式：仅使用标准库的实现大多数情况下与参考库性能相当（2倍以内）；在架构开销占主导的场景中，许多实现比参考库快5倍至115倍；而对于依赖C扩展的计算（图像处理、二进制序列化、底层加密）则出现明显的性能断崖，这一点通过PyPy JIT和性能剖析实验得到证实。除速度之外，标准库模块将安装占用空间降低了几个数量级（中位数31 KB对比700 KB），导入速度快2.2倍，并消除了88个传递依赖。
tldr: 本研究构建了zerodep——44个仅用Python标准库实现的单文件模块并与第三方参考库进行基准对比，发现大多数场景下零依赖实现性能相当甚至快5-115倍，仅在C扩展支撑的计算场景存在性能断崖，同时大幅减小安装体积、加快导入速度并消除供应链风险。
en_tdlr: This study presents zerodep, 44 single-file stdlib-only Python modules benchmarked against their reference libraries, showing that zero-dependency implementations achieve parity or 5x-115x speedups in most cases, with performance cliffs only for C-extension-backed computation, while drastically reducing footprint, import time, and supply-chain risk.
